title: Dam Keeper
brief: Rain fills a reservoir; tap the sluice gate to turn water into power, but the turbine only runs while the water stands at 5 or more. Reach 40 power to win; let the reservoir reach 10 and the dam bursts.

title: Firefly Jar
brief: Fireflies drift over a night meadow and glow for brief moments; tap them while they glow to put them in the jar. Catch 20 before dawn to win; tapping a dark firefly costs one of 3 lives, and after midnight the glows get shorter.

title: Balloon Drift
brief: A hot-air balloon sinks one level every few seconds as its air cools; swipe up to fire the burner (uses fuel), swipe down to vent, dodge gulls and catch fuel canisters. Stay aloft until the 50 km crossing is done; touching the ground ends the flight.

title: Hive Keeper
brief: Tap blooming flowers to send forager bees home; each returning bee adds honey and a comb cell. The summer heats the hive and wasps stir it up, so swat wasps and tap the fan to cool it. Win at 24 honey; if the heat reaches 10 the colony swarms away.

title: Reef Tank
brief: Keep an aquarium alive for a week: tap the bubbler for oxygen, drop food from three hatches as fish swim below, and swipe to scrub algae off the glass. Well-fed fish breed and breathe more air; the tank is lost if oxygen hits 0, hunger reaches 10 or algae reaches 8.

title: Storm Desk
brief: Weather fronts close in on a weather station from four sides, each announced by the radar a moment early. Swipe toward a storm to raise that shield (costs battery) and let sunshine through to recharge; 20 readings win, and 3 storms reaching the station wreck it.

title: Lantern Fuse
brief: A two-board chain-reaction puzzle: a lit lantern ignites the fuses leading away from it, and a damp lantern needs fire from two sides. Spend your few sparks on the right lanterns so every one lights; if the sparks run out with lanterns still dark, the board resets. Light both boards to win.

title: Irrigation Rows
brief: Four farm plots dry out at different speeds and only grow while their soil moisture stays between 3 and 7. Swipe left and right to move the sprinkler, up to water and down to pump water back out; 100 harvest wins, and a plot that dries out or floods costs one of 3 lives.

title: Glasshouse
brief: Seedlings sprout in empty greenhouse beds and drink from the water tank at every growth step; tap ripe tomatoes to harvest and withered plants to clear the bed. Swipe up to pump water and down to mist away aphids; 18 tomatoes win, 6 lost plants lose.

title: Sort Line
brief: Rubbish rides a conveyor into a diverter: swipe up for the paper chute, down for the glass chute, right to let cans run on. A wrong bin or a spill costs one of 3 lives; sort 12 on the morning shift and 20 more on the faster night shift to win.

title: Potion Bench
brief: An order card names a recipe of red, blue and green; tap the three valves to pour exactly that much and the potion is bottled. Pouring one drop too many or letting the candle burn down boils the brew over and costs one of 3 lives; bottle 8 potions to win.

title: Crossroads
brief: Run the traffic lights of one junction: swipe anywhere to give the other road green, after a short all-red pause. Cars and trucks queue at red; switching while one is still crossing causes a crash (3 lives), and 9 vehicles waiting at once is gridlock. Let 30 through to win.

title: Reactor Shift
brief: Run a power station for one shift: swipe up to pull the control rods out for more power and heat, swipe down to push them in, and tap the pump to spend coolant. Deliver 150 units before the shift ends; random pump jams and heat spikes push the core toward an automatic scram at 14 and a meltdown at 18.

title: Night Bakery
brief: Three nights in a bakery with more ovens each night: tap an empty oven to load dough (uses flour from the sack) and tap it again when golden before the loaf burns. Three burnt loaves fill the kitchen with smoke and restart the night, rush orders count double, and blown fuses darken ovens on night three. Meet every quota before dawn to win.

title: Orbit Station
brief: Keep a damaged space station alive until the rescue shuttle docks: tap the scrubber, solar panel and recycler to top up oxygen, power and water, which all drain. The scrubber and recycler need power, the solar panel only works on the day side, broken systems need 3 repair taps, and drifting debris must be tapped away; any meter reaching 0 ends the mission.
